title: Bread of the Presence
summary: The bread of the Presence was placed before the Lord and connected with priestly service, provision, and holy space.
background: Also called showbread, this bread was set in the holy place. Jesus refers to David eating it when teaching about mercy and Sabbath controversy.
teachingHelp: Use this topic to clarify temple holiness and why Jesus’ reference to David matters in the Sabbath dispute.
